backlog.note: Phase 8 shipped with browser checks but no integration tests: the dues gate, the member_monthly projection and the join link are unproved in CI. Testcontainers DOES run on this WSL host (`pnpm test:integration` = 37 files, 308 tests), so the tests can now be written — only the phase 8 ones are missing.
Staff still see three plan chips (VIP, listing, neither), so a member paying $4.99 reads as 'free' in the console.
src/domain/pricing.ts decides what the pages say; plan_prices decides what Stripe charges. Changing a price in the console without changing the table makes the copy lie.

Typing +380000000000 (ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_OWNER_PHONE) into the phone field submits +38000000000 — AsYouType strips the leading zero as a trunk prefix. Real member numbers round-trip correctly; the staff owner cannot sign in by typing their own number.
Production /health/deep reported degraded on 2026-09-08: 2 outbox messages pending since 2026-08-29. Email delivery for company/billing notifications is not draining.

20260912100000_public_catalogue must run on production for 'Our partners' to stop redirecting to sign-in. It sets the flag rather than inserting it, so it also fixes a database where the row exists and reads false.

tests/member-plan-filter.integration.test.ts fails 3 of 6 (FR-083): countMembersByPlan returns 0 where the test expects 1. Confirmed pre-existing on 2026-09-12 by stashing an unrelated change and re-running. Likely fallout from phase 8 adding subscriptions.plan, which the count query may not read. Not in `pnpm verify` — integration runs separately.

--accent-foreground was fixed to near-black in dark mode (3.19:1 -> 6.21:1). --primary-foreground is still #ffffff over --primary #b18a44, the identical pair; axe did not flag it on the landing page, so it is unproven rather than fine. Worth an axe pass over a dark catalogue and dashboard.

`pnpm db:seed:landing` wrote nine invented partners (slug `landing-demo-%`) plus the full taxonomy into the docker-compose database so the redesigned landing has something to read. `pnpm db:seed:landing --remove` takes the partners out; the taxonomy is real reference data and stays.

The redesigned landing's behaviour - live catalogue search, the custom select, the reveal observer - is proved by hand in a browser, not in CI. Only the pure helpers are tested (landing-partner, partner-presentation, club-stats). A Playwright test for 'type dental, see one card' would be the cheapest real cover.

A partner account is held on /{locale}/membership until the listing is paid for, so a typo in a pending application waits for a moderator to reject it. No edit path, and photos cannot be added after submission either.
ADR 0036 says to revisit the payment-after-moderation order if more than about a quarter of approved applications are never paid for. Nothing counts that today.

The bug that made registration 'work every other time' (React resetting uncontrolled fields after a form action, emptying the required name and email) was found by hand in a browser and is fixed, but nothing in CI would catch it coming back. A Playwright test - refuse an attempt, check every field still holds its value, resubmit - is the cheapest real cover.

registerPartnerAction (account + company in one submit) is covered by no automated test - it needs Next's request scope, which neither the unit nor the integration suite provides. It was walked by hand in a browser on 2026-09-24 and works; submitCompany has 10 integration tests.

Playwright's Chromium needs libnspr4, libnss3 and libasound2, which this host lacks and cannot install without sudo. Workaround that works: `apt-get download libnspr4 libnss3 libasound2t64`, `dpkg -x` into a local prefix, then run with LD_LIBRARY_PATH pointing at it. Replaces the old 'e2e cannot launch chromium' item.

.env.local has no ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_OWNER_PHONE/PASSWORD, so the run-kclub driver cannot sign in as staff and no console screen can be driven here. The dev database does hold a staff_owner (+380900000001, TOTP enabled) - only the password is missing.
